about: Machine-readable twin of the BTC — EVERYTHING hub (btc.html), NODAL desk. Same numbers, same sources. All times ET. SIM and REAL records are always labelled and never blended.
how_the_vote_works: Every seated engine reads each 5-minute BTC window and calls UP, DOWN, or PASS, sealed before the window ends.
Real-money lanes fire only on a UNANIMOUS vote — one dissent and the window is a no-fire.
Penny law (HOUSE lane): strike only a side crashed to 5¢ or less, $0.25 flat, 30¢ recovery exit, remainder rides.

Grading: every call is graded TRUE or NOT against the venue settlement (Polymarket US). Timestamps are law — a call counts from when it was posted; a call posted after its window settles does not count.
Follow lanes (ASHEN / PIZZA / TERRY) mirror an outside caller's sealed calls at a $1.00 bank; PROS mirrors two public wallets tracked by address only.

engines.name: PLAIN
engines.blurb: The desk's careful caller — one sealed call per 5-minute window, behind a confidence floor. The original engine; every other lane is measured against it.

engines.name: THE EARLY CALLER (EARLY)
engines.blurb: Calls about 30 seconds sooner than PLAIN on the same window; can bank value when its side runs to 88% and flip its answer if the move turns.

engines.name: RIPTIDE
engines.blurb: The aggressive third model, born from PLAIN + EARLY — rides wrong-way dips. SIM money line only: no real money behind this record.

record.kind: SIM money line — sealed plays graded at entry/exit averages, fees in

engines.name: THE FINAL CALL (FINAL)
engines.blurb: Fires only when PLAIN and EARLY agree on the final side, both reads at 85% or better, and the ask sits under the value line. Graded on money, not direction — a directional win that loses money is a money loss.

engines.name: HOUSE (penny-strike lane)
engines.blurb: The house's own lane. Fires only on a unanimous vote, and only strikes a side that has crashed to 5¢ or less — $0.25 flat, a 30¢ recovery exit, the remainder rides.
engines.bank_note: executor's book (the executor's own ledger figure)
engines.note: Penny-strike fills are sealed one by one in the ledger; the desk feeds publish no summary W–L row for HOUSE yet, so none is shown.

engines.name: PROS (follow-the-pros lane)
engines.blurb: Follows two public Polymarket wallets, tracked by public address only — the same public-link tracking anyone can join with (see BRING YOUR OWN, below). Opposite entries inside one window = the lane stands down.
engines.note: Watcher is live and armed; the desk feeds publish no graded summary row for PROS yet, so none is shown.

join.what_we_need: ONE public link: a Polymarket profile link or public wallet address, OR a Discord link/handle. PUBLIC LINKS ONLY — never private keys, seed phrases, or API secrets.
join.law: Your call counts from the timestamp you said it. We check it against how the window actually settled. True or not — that's your record.
